basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A named location instance in a gazetteer register, not an address or a land parcel.
Treats names as attested assertions with language, script and time, not fixed labels.
Differs from an administrative unit, whose boundaries are legally defined.
Differs from a point of interest, which adds business operations such as opening hours.

may: Resolve a place name to candidate records with positions.
Reverse geocode a position to candidate places.
Propose new names or corrections with sources.
mustNot: Present a name as official without naming the deciding authority.
Pick a winner in a naming or sovereignty dispute.
Reuse or delete identifiers instead of deprecating them.
Reveal precise positions of sensitive sites beyond permitted resolution.
Treat a representative point as the place's boundary.

considerations: Place names carry cultural and political meaning; Indigenous and minority names deserve recognition.
Precise locations of sacred, archaeological or endangered species sites can lead to harm.
Disputed territories need neutral recording of competing claims.
affectedParties: Communities who use and own place names
Users relying on places for navigation and emergency response

items: A gazetteer place has an identifier, names, a place type, a representative position and a source register.
On the ground it is matched by signage, landmarks and position within stated accuracy.
Confused with addresses, administrative units, points of interest and map labels.
Emergency services sent to the wrong same-named place.
Offence or conflict from imposed or disputed names.
ISO 19112 spatial referencing by geographic identifiers.
ISO 19162 well-known text for coordinate reference systems.
BCP 47, ISO 639 and ISO 15924 for language and script tags.
Representative position as latitude and longitude in decimal degrees, with the CRS declared.
Elevation in metres with the vertical datum stated.
Extent or area in square metres or square kilometres, with the geometry source stated.
Positional accuracy in metres at a stated confidence level.
Observation or survey date for each position and geometry.
